about: Fiducial-marker types (BSD-3-Clause; spectra keys 'fp:<id>' are FPbase, CC BY-SA 4.0, 'paper:<curve>' data/fiducials/paper_spectra.json, CC BY 3.0). A bead is one emitter per component: 'emitters' equivalent dyes (equivalentDye: extinction coefficient and quantum yield) at the type's reference diameter, scaled with the volume, with the component's spectra; it bleaches (when 'bleaches') with the fiducial bleach half-time at the reference intensity at its own excitation peak. 'calibration' fits 'emitters' (tools/fiducial_spectra/fit.mjs): the bead's maximum pixel above the background relative to a single reference molecule's in the same images of balinovic2019 (EM gain 300, both through the same laser and filter), so emitters = ratio x (eps QY readout of the reference) / (eps QY of the equivalent dye x the bead's excitation at the laser x its emission in the band, computed from its curves). The max-pixel readings (histogram modes) and the background (900 AD-counts, the images' colour-scale floor) are read by eye: estimates, +-50 %. 'scatter': elastic scattering of the laser lines (gold: Mie, gold_mie.json), detected through the filters' blocking.

equivalentDye.notes: definition (estimate): a component's brightness is that of 'emitters' dyes with eps 100000 /M/cm and QY 0.5 at its excitation peak

mEos3.2.notes: mEos3.2 red state (FPbase scalars; the paper's A69T variant assumed the same); read-out 93 % through ET610/75, 94 % through ET605/70 (balinovic2019 figs 2a, 4a)

JF646.notes: Janelia Fluor 646 (FPbase: JF646-HaloTag conjugate; the paper's JF646-Hoechst assumed the same); read-out 41 % at 640 nm through HC 676/29 (balinovic2019 fig. 5b)

defaults.notes: density 0 = no fiducials (off). Diameter spread 12 % (estimate; vendors quote a few % for FluoSpheres, aggregates and doublets widen it). Bleach half-time 8 h at 1 kW/cm^2 at each component's excitation peak (estimate). Default type gold and height OnTop (the beads on the sample: what a drift-correction sample usually has; the user's choice, 2026-10-23).

types.name: Gold nanoparticles (100 nm)

calibration.notes: gold max pixel ~5000, mEos3.2 ~2500 (fig. 2c, d; background 900)

types.notes: Sigma-Aldrich 100 nm gold (balinovic2019): stable, few spikes; aggregates blink (not modelled). Photoluminescence as measured; the laser lines' elastic scattering is a second channel (Mie), blocked by the dichroic and emission filter down to their blocking floor.
